scope: Opt-in Node debug logging; plugin and wire contracts unchanged

checks.name: disabled debugging creates no files and does not format messages
small debug entries preserve timestamp, PID and text without stdout output
sustained logging rotates within one process
repeated rotations keep only one previous generation
large Unicode entries are bounded and end on a valid UTF-8 boundary
an existing oversized log is preserved as the previous generation
failed rotation does not append past the threshold and logging can recover
file failures emit bounded, rate-limited stderr diagnostics
message conversion failures cannot escape debugLog
concurrent processes retain rotating UTF-8 logs without protocol output

limits: Shared-process rotation is best effort, not a global file-size transaction
An existing oversized historical log is preserved as one backup until the next rotation
Logging stays synchronous when enabled; no throughput gain is claimed
Caller allocations, retained agent state and total process memory are outside this change
